summary: PROFILE=mimo26-flash and PRESET=mimo26-flash-tp2: MiMo-V2.6-Flash with DFlash on b12x
compatibility: New profile and preset; requires the MiMo-V2.6 series in vLLM and b12x.
details: Serves XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (revision 5711b268) with text, images and audio, FP8 KV and the checkpoint's DFlash drafter (7 tokens, adaptive verification).
PRESET=mimo26-flash-tp2 runs on two GPUs with 1.31M KV tokens (full 1M context); video input is off at TP2.
